stacksmith.tooltip.get: Put the item in your inventory, like the creative menu does. Works on any server in creative, no op needed, any size.
stacksmith.tooltip.copy_give: Copy the /give command to the clipboard.
stacksmith.tooltip.copy_data: Copy the item as saved data ({id:...,components:{...}}), for /data, loot tables or other items.
stacksmith.tooltip.run_too_long: The command is %s characters; chat takes 256. Use Get item, or paste it into a command block.
stacksmith.tooltip.run_no_permission: This server doesn't let you use /give. Get item still works in creative.
stacksmith.tooltip.length_ok: Characters in the command. Chat takes up to 256.
stacksmith.tooltip.length_long: Too long to type in chat (256). Get item has no limit; a command block takes up to 32500.
stacksmith.tooltip.get_spawner: A spawner item that places this spawner (needs op on servers).
stacksmith.tooltip.get_command_block: A command block that turns itself into this spawner as soon as you place it: always active, no redstone. Needs op and command blocks enabled.
stacksmith.tooltip.place: Run /setblock on the block you're looking at.
stacksmith.tooltip.place_no_permission: This server doesn't let you use /setblock.
stacksmith.tooltip.place_too_long: Too long to send from chat (256). Use Get command block instead.
stacksmith.tooltip.copy_summon: Copy a /summon of the selected mob.
stacksmith.tooltip.import_block: Look at a spawner first. Operators get its full data; others get what the client sees (the shown mob).
